thread:
sam: Heads up — I need an expedited approval to push a hotfix to prod-embeds (kv-cache leak). Out of normal change window, this is a high-impact tail latency regression seen in canary. https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4821
joel: TL;DR: leak causes KV cache growth -> OOM risk on busy hosts. Fix is a single-line guard + metrics. PR: #4821. Built image: redwood/embeds:v2026.03.19-hotfix1
rachel: Can we confirm rollback plan + quick smoke steps? I can approve if ops is comfortable. :thumbsup:
maya: Oncall here. Rollback criteria I want monitored: >3% 5xx across embed calls for 5m OR p95 latency +200ms sustained for 5m. If either hits, we roll back. Also need a canary for 10% traffic for 15m with tracing checks.
sam: Agreed. Proposed steps: 1) pin canary to v2026.03.19-hotfix1 on embed-service-canary 10% 2) wait 15m, check errors/latency/traces 3) if green, ramp to 100% with staged increments 25/50/100.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] queued rollout: service=prod-embeds image=redwood/embeds:v2026.03.19-hotfix1 strategy=canary(10%/15m) requested_by=sam
joel: Smoke checklist: run /ops/smoke/embeds.sh (quick sanity), verify trace IDs show no kv-cache spikes, check memory RSS on canary hosts.
rachel: I approve pending oncall ack. Approving: rachel :white_check_mark:
maya: Oncall ack and monitoring hooks in place. I'll keep a private pager for 40 minutes. Approving: maya :white_check_mark:
sam: tagging @ops-oncall for additional visibility, please watch dashboard (dashboards/embeds/kv-cache).
ops-oncall: Watching now. Will escalate to infra if host OOMs or autoscaler misbehaves.
deploy-bot: canary rollout started: 10% -> 3 pods updated. Canaries will be evaluated at +15m.
joel: running smoke now -> `./ops/smoke/embeds.sh canary` shows basic inference ok, no obvious errors.
releasebot: Release note draft created: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/2026-03-19-hotfix-kv-cache (please add short blurb)
sam: blurb added. Short: "Fix kv-cache growth under long-running sessions that could cause elevated memory; mitigates OOM risk for heavy embed traffic."
maya: 7m into canary: traces look normal, memory stable on canary hosts. No increase in 5xx.
ops-oncall: metrics: 0.4% 5xx, p95 +10ms. Green.
deploy-bot: canary check passed -> proceeding to staged ramp: 25% -> 50% -> 100% with 5m pauses between stages.
joel: pinned image in infra artifact registry: image tag v2026.03.19-hotfix1 immutable digest sha256:abcdef1234567890
rachel: Thanks all. Approving full rollout. :rocket:
sam: Starting ramp now. Will watch until 30m after 100%.
maya: Reminder: rollback command if criteria hit: `deploy-bot rollback service=prod-embeds to_image=redwood/embeds:v2026.03.18` (previous stable). Keep me in the loop.
ops-oncall: Noted. Alerting thresholds are set, contact list updated.
deploy-bot: rollout complete: prod-embeds -> image=redwood/embeds:v2026.03.19-hotfix1 100% at 7391122438
sam: Great job folks. Post-deploy checks: no new alerts in first 20m. I'll update the release note and close the thread. :party-parrot:
releasebot: release notes published: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/2026-03-19-hotfix-kv-cache published_by=sam
joel: adding follow-up ops task to track memory trend for 48h.
maya: I'll keep the pager awake for the next 2 hours just to be safe.
sam: closing loop — thanks for quick turns and approvals.
